exposure: Use of prostaglandins for labor induction
outcome: Cesarean delivery for nonreassuring fetal status (NRFS)
Maternal morbidity (transfusion, postpartum hemorrhage, wound infection, endometritis, fever)
Neonatal morbidity (5-min Apgar score <7, admission to the neonatal intensive care unit, neonatal death)
cohort: 1097 singleton pregnancies at or after 37 weeks gestation complicated by delivery of small-for-gestational age (SGA) neonates
finding: In propensity score analysis, there was no association between the use of prostaglandins for labor induction at term and cesarean for NRFS in pregnancies complicated by SGA.
mod_finding: The study found no association between the use of prostaglandins for labor induction and cesarean delivery for nonreassuring fetal status in pregnancies complicated by small for gestational age.
